theme: Mid-July Dal Lake demand and loss-aversion - cool monsoon nights, travellers wanting the real houseboat stay; the unlisted boat loses tonight's guest to a listed one
season: Mid-summer (13 July 2026). The Amarnath Yatra is underway (2 Jul - mid Aug), so Pahalgam and Sonamarg roads run heavy with pilgrim traffic; start early and book ahead. Srinagar is warm by day and cool at dawn (~15-32C) with frequent afternoon monsoon showers, so mornings are the window; the Mughal gardens are in full bloom and the Dal is glass-still at first light. Gulmarg and the high meadows are lush, green and cool (~10-18C) with the gondola running, while the plains sit above 40C. Valley travel runs roughly 7am-6pm.
campaign_name: Houseboats mid-July Dal Lake demand loss-aversion [INR] - 13 Jul 2026
subject: A cool Dal Lake night just booked another houseboat
